criteria.description: Computes the inclusive four-day span, both local point totals, their 120.7 mm mean, and the 54.5 mm daily maximum.
criteria.name: local_rainfall_extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct series extraction with small rounding errors or one missing local aggregate.

criteria.description: Counts days at or above 10 mm in both local series and computes the conservative fraction as 1.000.
criteria.name: persistence_fraction
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct heavy-day counting for one series or a correct numerator with an incorrect span.

criteria.description: Extracts the three regional mean precipitation values, uses 8.871 mm as the maximum, and computes the 13.606 point-to-regional ratio.
criteria.name: regional_scale_ratio
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct regional extraction or a correct ratio formula with minor rounding drift.

criteria.description: Computes the image-shift index of 0.651 from all RGB pixels in the package JPEG images as delivered, and extracts annual_change_mean of 0.0611.
criteria.name: image_and_annual_terms
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct image fractions or annual extraction when the combined image index is incomplete.

criteria.description: Applies all capped component formulas and the weighted sum to reach rainfall_scale_score 0.874 within 0.005.
criteria.name: component_score
criteria.partial_credit: Credit a correct component ledger with an arithmetic slip in the weighted sum.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON containing anchors, components, the score, and the class label localized_persistent_rainfall_dominant.
criteria.name: json_result
criteria.partial_credit: Credit the correct score and class when the JSON shape needs minor cleanup.

image_method.no_data_handling: no separate no-data mask is applied to the JPEG browse images
image_method.pixel_scope: all RGB pixels in each package JPEG image as delivered
